_doc: Provenance for the RPT-1 (#2000) golden-file fixtures. These are minimal, committed slices of REAL NVDA data so the deterministic FactSet golden test runs self-contained in CI (the source parquets are local-only). Derived once via scratchpad/gen_rpt1_fixtures.py; values are NOT hand-edited.

nvda_bars.json.window: last 260 trading days <= as_of (>=252 needed to reproduce the 52-week low)

nvda_lstm_xsec.json.window: cross-sectional row on as_of (all non-null universe symbols)

nvda_news.json.window: curated real NVDA catalysts, all published_utc <= as_of (incl. the earnings-CC)

caveat_v1_panel: v1_pred.parquet is a session artifact with a random 80/20 split (leakage). The FactSet surfaces this via model_card.leakage_caveat; the fixture is only used to prove the deterministic FACT layer, not model validity.
